new_artifacts.claim: Strict Agent Trace 0.1.0 attribution import without authority/safety/provider-fidelity inference
Pins attribution-only boundary, foreign hash qualification, URI non-dereference, metadata non-promotion and revision/path validation
Branch-scoped syntax and contract validation for Runpod migration and Agent Trace import organs

validation_noncauses: Validation-fork PR-policy failures on source pushes are caused by upstream-only autosync credential availability, not implementation behavior.
The volunteer receipt workflow is intentionally skipped on the validation-only PR because no receipt opt-in trailer is present.

agentguard_214.known_bug: _normalized_path converts backslashes to slash before PurePosixPath absolute detection, so a Windows drive-root such as C:/... is not considered absolute on POSIX hosts.
agentguard_214.required_fix: Reject ^[A-Za-z]:[\\/] and UNC roots before normalization; preserve non-echoing diagnostic.
agentguard_214.reason_not_applied_here: GitHub connector exposes whole-file replacement for a large module; local gh/Run8 can apply the surgical patch with materially less bandwidth and risk.

regression_fences_added: Agent Trace imported model_id is attribution metadata and must never imply provider fidelity.
Foreign content_hash remains algorithm-qualified and never becomes Bonfyre security identity by relabeling.
Foreign metadata is bound by digest but not automatically promoted into EvidenceGraph fields.
Conversation/related URIs remain references unless a separately authorized retrieval creates evidence.
VCS line attribution is revision-relative; current working-tree line positions are not interchangeable.
